parameters.content:
## 1. Load the HubSpot deal
Deal, associated contact and line items, with checks before anything is written to BC. The Stop nodes below give a plain-English error.

## 2. Business Central customer
Contact has a BC ID: find + update. No BC ID: create + write the number back to the HubSpot contact.

## 3. Sales order
Create order (header + lines), write the number to the deal (bc_order_id), then set the page-only fields.

## 4. Primary contact (optional extra)
Creates the HubSpot contact as a BC Person contact (or reuses it) and sets it as the customer's primary contact.

## NWI - Deal -> BC Customer + Sales Order: set up before publishing
1. Webhook node: connect header-auth credential **NWI HubSpot Webhook Auth** (see the HubSpot header note in the PR). Publish, then point the HubSpot webhook subscription (Deal property `dealstage`) at the PRODUCTION URL.
2. Connect credentials: **NWI HubSpot App Token** (HubSpot app token, scopes: crm.objects.deals.read/write, contacts.read/write, line_items read) and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)** on every HTTP node. Confirm no "not connected" warning remains on any node.
3. One BC customer per HubSpot contact; the BC customer name is the contact's Company name property. *Workflow Config* (an Edit Fields node, no code) holds every setting: BC base URL (tenant + environment), company, default posting group for new customers, the HubSpot properties fetched and the country map. Subscribe the HubSpot webhook to the property change that means closed won.
4. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler.
5. Confirm HubSpot properties exist: CONTACT `business_central_record_id` and deal `bc_order_id` (both single-line text). 
6. BC web service **Customer_Card** (page 21) must stay published: new customers are created through it. Fix the customer templates' GST group in BC if you want to return to the standard API.
7. Primary contact: after the order, the HubSpot contact is created as a BC Person contact under the customer's company contact and set as Primary Contact No. (shows as ERC Primary Contact Name). This runs after the order is created, so a failure here never blocks the order.
8. BC web service **SalesOrder** (page 42) must stay published: after the order is created and bc_order_id is written, the order page fields are set through it.
9. Confirm BC item numbers equal HubSpot line item SKUs.

**Real time, no fan-out:** one deal per execution. Order lines go to BC in one call.
**Duplicate guard:** a deal that already has bc_order_id is skipped. The BC order's Purchase order No. is left blank, so BC has no copy of the deal ID: if the order is created but the write-back to the deal fails, fix bc_order_id by hand before re-running.

**Request bodies:** every HTTP node shows the exact JSON it sends in its Body field. A blank HubSpot value is left out (`|| undefined`), so it never wipes a BC value. There are no Code nodes in this workflow.
